jei.ironbackpacks.increaseTier.desc: To increase the tier of a backpack, simply follow the desired §2crafting recipe§r. You may have to choose between different types of backpacks when upgrading. Choose wisely!
jei.ironbackpacks.increaseTier.desc2: Note that when upgrading to a new tier you automatically keep all items, upgrades, configurations, etc. present in the previous backpack!
jei.ironbackpacks.increaseTier.name: Increase Backpack Tier
upgrade.ironbackpacks.damage_bar.desc: Adds a damage bar to visually represent how full the backpack is at a glance.
upgrade.ironbackpacks.everlasting.desc: Keeps backpacks that have been dropped from de-spawning.
upgrade.ironbackpacks.lock.desc: Locks everybody but the owner out of the pack.
